description: The server's definition of the active-attention axis and of the §6 surface indicators, shared by both layers. Transcribed from packages/server/lib/data/repository/attention_dismissible_sql.dart and from the totals packages/server/test/data/repository/attention_active_attention_axis_pg_test.dart asserts against a real Postgres projection. Both layers read this file: client tests drive their expected totals from it instead of hand-building a number that looks right (U15R-c, overseer addition 1), and since U15R-d the server PG test that produces those numbers reads it too, so drift is caught from both ends.

predicates._activeAttentionMeaning: activeOptional OR liveObligation — recorded as the composition the server source literally writes, so drift in either half is caught by its own entry

axisCases.name: seen but uncleared optional receipt still asks for attention
axisCases.note: reading is not clearing (D02): seen_at must not decide the dot

axisCases.name: unseen but cleared optional receipt no longer asks
a live obligation is active attention even when seen
axisCases.note: §6 splits what the legacy `myWorkUnreadTotal` fuses: the obligation is `my desk.count`, never `my desk.dot`. `myWorkUnreadTotal` still counts it and retires in U18.

axisCases.name: a settled obligation stops being active attention

groupEventUnseenCount.definition: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE activeOptional(child)) over primary-placement activity children
groupEventUnseenCount.note: eventUnseenCount is NOT a read count. A child that is seen but uncleared still counts; only cleared children drop out.

setO.description: dismissible outcome rows (inbox_item axis); excludes anything in eligible_pinned, i.e. an unanswered forward awaiting a decision (owner decision A)

unreadViewMembershipByItemKind.description: `is_active_attention` is not one expression. The stream union in attention_repository.dart gives each item_kind its own, and the client's `isInUnreadView` mirrors this table. R10: U15R-c applied the `receipt` rule to all four kinds, so a requestActivity card whose last optional child was cleared stayed on a list the server had already dropped it from.
unreadViewMembershipByItemKind.forward: false — an outcome row is dismissible but never carries the dot (U15R-a/R1)

surfaceSummaryFields.description: What `AttentionRepository.surfaceSummary` returns, and which §6 rule each field is. §6 states four rules; before U15R-d the summary returned three fields and none of them was any of the four.
surfaceSummaryFields.myDeskDot: §6 `my desk.dot` — any owned Request has an uncleared optional event or uncleared outcome. Composed as activeOptional ∧ primaryPlacement on surface='myWork', OR a Set O row whose beacon is in `scope`. Live obligations are excluded: they are the number (D09).
surfaceSummaryFields.forYouDot: §6 `for you.dot` — Set R (dismissible optional receipts, wrapped in primaryPlacement) ∪ Set O (dismissible outcomes) ∪ eligible_pinned (the pending-forward zone) ∪ pending prompts.
surfaceSummaryFields.pendingPrompts: Written into the for-you dot as an explicit `OR FALSE` with a comment naming what it waits for. No classified prompt event has a row in any of the three sets yet (U09a); silent absence would be indistinguishable from a deleted predicate.
surfaceSummaryFields.forYouCount: Does not exist, at any layer. §6: `for you.count = never`. The absent field is what makes that structural rather than a convention a widget can break.
surfaceSummaryFields.legacyTotals: `activityUnreadTotal`, `myWorkUnreadTotal` and `needsYouTotal` keep their pre-U15R-d meaning (activeAttention per surface; every live obligation, unscoped) and retire in U18. U15R-d is additive by §0.2.
surfaceSummaryFields.obligationsAlwaysNameARequest: m0191 (`notification_outbox__obligation_beacon_chk`, `CHECK (NOT requires_action OR beacon_id IS NOT NULL)`) makes a Request-less live obligation unstorable. Until U15R-e it was storable — m0115's `notification_outbox__beacon_policy_chk` demands a `beacon_id` only for the `beacon_content` / `beacon_tombstone` access policies — and `visibleWithSurface` labelled every beacon-less row `activity`, where §6 offers it neither a count nor a dot term. The constraint states the rule the producer already enforced (`AttentionPolicy.logicalTaskKey` throws `Live obligation requires a Request`) where nothing can route around it, and it validates on ADD so a legacy violating row aborts the migration rather than being skipped or repaired (legacy remediation is U18's). Pinned by the PG test 'U15R-e — a Request-less live obligation is rejected by notification_outbox__obligation_beacon_chk', asserted by constraint name.
